milestones.name: Data and Setup
milestones.description: Load the CoDEx-M graph, report verifiable graph statistics, and save entity and relation embeddings for both models

criteria.description: kg_stats.json entity, relation and triple counts match recomputation from the shipped files
Entity and relation embedding matrices exist for both models with the right shapes, finite non-degenerate values, and matching dimensions

milestones.name: Model Development and Ranking
milestones.description: Train TransE and a relation-aware GNN independently and rank every evaluation query from the trained parameters

criteria.description: Both ranking files cover every evaluation query exactly once with valid, non-repeating candidate lists
Submitted rankings reproduce from the saved embeddings under a standard scoring rule
The saved R-GCN input embeddings and per-relation transforms replay over the training graph to reproduce the saved rgcn embeddings, with transforms that genuinely differ by relation
The TransE and GNN rankings disagree often enough to be two independently trained models
Both models beat the popularity baseline on held-out queries
Held-out link prediction results stay within the range this benchmark supports rather than indicating leaked answers

milestones.name: Evaluation and Relation Analysis
milestones.description: Verify every reported metric and relation-level conclusion against recomputation from the prediction files

criteria.description: lp_results.json overall and per-relation validation metrics match recomputation from the ranking files
relation_analysis.json per-relation metrics, hardest and easiest relations, and the frequency correlation verify against recomputation
metrics.json matches recomputed validation values and model_config.json describes both models

milestones.name: Deliverables and Report
milestones.description: Written report meets quality standards. critical=false: failing this milestone costs rubric points but does not fail the task

criteria.description: report.md exists with at least 300 words
Report covers the models, the metrics, relation difficulty and caveats, and quotes the actual measured values
